hints.title: Strictly Increasing GCD Condition
hints.text: Every adjacent pair (nums[i], nums[i+1]) must satisfy gcd > 1 and nums[i] < nums[i+1].

hints.title: Stepwise Prime Factor Extension
hints.text: From index downwards to 0, elements decrease by at least their prime factor step. From index upwards to n - 1, elements increase by their shared gcd step.

hints.title: Minimal Extension Greedy Assignment
hints.text: To minimize the maximum value nums[n-1], pick the smallest valid shared factors (like 2 for even chains) to minimize the final element.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Prime factor analysis for minimal GCD step propagation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all combinations of increasing integers exceeds limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that minimizing the ending element requires minimizing each intermediate additive step.
